OpenAI's Dot Can Now Use More Than One Of Your Computers At The Same Time

Every developer knows this wait.

You start a build or a long test run. The fans spin up. The laptop slows down. You stop coding until it finishes.

Many people have a second machine on the desk that sits idle the whole time.

On 9 November, OpenAI gave its dots a way to use that machine.

𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁, 𝘄𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗮 𝗱𝗼𝘁 𝗶𝘀

OpenAI's docs call it "𝘢𝘯 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴-𝘰𝘯 𝘢𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘬𝘦𝘦𝘱𝘴 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘬 𝘮𝘰𝘷𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢𝘤𝘳𝘰𝘴𝘴 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘵𝘰𝘰𝘭𝘴 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘫𝘦𝘤𝘵𝘴". It lives in the cloud with its own computer and browser, and you message it from ChatGPT, Slack or Teams.

You could already connect your own computer to it. 𝗡𝗼𝘄 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝘀𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗹.

The docs: "𝘠𝘰𝘶 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘤𝘵 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘯 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘱𝘶𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘦𝘭𝘭 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘥𝘰𝘵 𝘸𝘩𝘪𝘤𝘩 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘶𝘴𝘦 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘢 𝘵𝘢𝘴𝘬."

𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘀

• 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗽: open the dot's profile in the ChatGPT app on each computer, find it under Computers, and select Allow
• 𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗽𝗵𝗼𝗻𝗲: access applies wherever you message the same dot
• 𝗕𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝘄𝗲𝗯𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗲𝘀: if a site blocks the cloud browser, you can ask the dot to try a connected computer

𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀

• 𝗔 𝘀𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗰 𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗲: OpenAI's example is testing a change in Xcode on a second Mac while you keep coding
• 𝗧𝘄𝗼 𝗲𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀: run the same test on a current setup and on an older SDK, then compare
• 𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗲𝘅: the dot can create local Work or Codex tasks and continue local Codex tasks that already exist

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘁𝘀

• 𝗢𝗻𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗽𝗲𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱. The docs say: "𝘌𝘢𝘤𝘩 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘥 𝘶𝘴𝘦𝘴 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘱𝘶𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘢𝘵 𝘢 𝘵𝘪𝘮𝘦." A single task is not split across machines
• 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗺𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗼𝗻, online, with the ChatGPT app open
• 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝘀𝗮𝘆𝘀 "𝗮𝘁 𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲". That means separate threads running side by side, not one job spread over many machines
• 𝗡𝗼 𝗺𝗮𝘅𝗶𝗺𝘂𝗺 𝗻𝘂𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 of computers is given in the docs
• Press reports say dots are on 𝗣𝗿𝗼 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗣𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝘂𝗺 plans only. OpenAI's page says plan and region rules apply
• More machines give more room to run things. 𝗧𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗱𝗼 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲

𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘢𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘯𝘰 𝘭𝘰𝘯𝘨𝘦𝘳 𝘵𝘪𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘰 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘦. 𝘠𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘮𝘢𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘴 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘣𝘦𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢 𝘴𝘮𝘢𝘭𝘭 𝘱𝘰𝘰𝘭 𝘪𝘵 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘱𝘪𝘤𝘬 𝘧𝘳𝘰𝘮.

zh-CN.title: OpenAI Dot 现在可以同时连接多台电脑
zh-CN.summary: 作者整理了 OpenAI 文档：自 11 月 9 日起，一个 dot 可连接多台电脑，并在任务中指定用哪台。设置方法是在每台电脑的 ChatGPT 应用里打开 dot 资料，在 Computers 下选择 Allow。例子包括用闲置 Mac 跑 Xcode 测试、在新旧 SDK 上对比测试。限制：每个线程一次只用一台电脑，电脑须保持开机在线并开着 ChatGPT 应用，文档未给出数量上限。

en.title: OpenAI Dot can now connect to several computers
en.summary: The author summarises OpenAI's docs: since 9 November a dot can connect to more than one computer and be told which one to use for a task. Setup: open the dot's profile in the ChatGPT app on each computer and select Allow under Computers. Examples include running Xcode tests on a spare Mac and comparing a test on a current and an older SDK. ko.title: OpenAI Dot, 이제 여러 컴퓨터에 동시에 연결 가능
ko.summary: 작성자는 OpenAI 문서를 정리했다. 11월 9일부터 dot은 여러 컴퓨터에 연결하고 작업마다 사용할 컴퓨터를 지정할 수 있다. 각 컴퓨터의 ChatGPT 앱에서 dot 프로필을 열고 Computers에서 Allow를 선택하면 된다. 남는 Mac에서 Xcode 테스트를 돌리거나 최신·구버전 SDK에서 같은 테스트를 비교하는 예가 있다. 제한: 스레드당 한 번에 한 대, 컴퓨터는 켜져 있고 온라인이며 ChatGPT 앱이 열려 있어야 하고, 최대 대수는 명시되지 않았다.

ms.title: OpenAI Dot kini boleh bersambung ke beberapa komputer
ms.summary: Penulis meringkaskan dokumen OpenAI: sejak 9 November, sebuah dot boleh bersambung ke lebih daripada satu komputer dan diberitahu komputer mana untuk sesuatu tugas. Caranya: buka profil dot dalam aplikasi ChatGPT di setiap komputer dan pilih Allow di bawah Computers. Contohnya menjalankan ujian Xcode pada Mac lapang dan membandingkan ujian pada SDK semasa dan lama. Had: satu komputer bagi setiap thread pada satu masa, mesin mesti hidup, dalam talian dengan aplikasi ChatGPT dibuka, dan tiada had maksimum dinyatakan.

vi.title: OpenAI Dot giờ có thể kết nối nhiều máy tính cùng lúc
vi.summary: Tác giả tóm tắt tài liệu của OpenAI: từ ngày 9/11, một dot có thể kết nối nhiều máy tính và được chỉ định dùng máy nào cho từng việc. Cách thiết lập: mở hồ sơ dot trong ứng dụng ChatGPT trên mỗi máy và chọn Allow trong mục Computers. Ví dụ gồm chạy test Xcode trên một máy Mac rảnh và so sánh test trên SDK mới và cũ. Giới hạn: mỗi luồng chỉ dùng một máy một lúc, máy phải bật, trực tuyến và mở ứng dụng ChatGPT, tài liệu không nêu số máy tối đa.

fr.title: OpenAI Dot peut désormais se connecter à plusieurs ordinateurs

de.title: OpenAI Dot kann jetzt mehrere Computer gleichzeitig nutzen
de.summary: Der Autor fasst OpenAIs Doku zusammen: Seit dem 9. November kann ein Dot mit mehreren Computern verbunden werden, und man sagt ihm, welchen er für eine Aufgabe nutzen soll. Einrichtung: In der ChatGPT-App auf jedem Computer das Dot-Profil öffnen und unter Computers Allow wählen. Beispiele: Xcode-Tests auf einem freien Mac laufen lassen, denselben Test auf aktuellem und älterem SDK vergleichen. Grenzen: ein Computer pro Thread zur selben Zeit, der Rechner muss an, online und mit offener ChatGPT-App sein, ein Maximum wird nicht genannt.

items.text:
I ASKED GROK BOT WHO STILL OWES ME MONEY.

IT SEARCHED 2 YEARS OF MY IMESSAGES AND FOUND $425.60 I F*CKING FORGOT ABOUT.

Concert tickets I covered. The Airbnb split nobody paid back. "I'll send it tomorrow" from a year ago.

Here's what it found:

→ My college friend: $212.00, his half of the Airbnb in Paris
→ My coworker: $89.00, the concert ticket I bought for him
→ My cousin: $46.50, her share of a dinner bill
→ My friend: $34.70, groceries "until payday"
→ Group chat: $25.00, a gift for a friend nobody chipped in for
→ My brother: $18.40, an Uber home after a night out

Every line came with the exact message and the date. No guessing, no "are you sure?". Just receipts.

Here's the prompt. Connect Messages, then paste:

"Search my iMessages from the last 2 years for money people owe me. Look for things like 'I'll pay you back', 'I owe you', 'send you my half' and amounts I covered for someone. Build one table: person, amount, what it was for, date, and the exact message. Mark anything that looks already paid. Don't message anyone."

Then the best part. Ask it:

"Draft a short, friendly reminder for each person on the list. Show me every draft and wait. Send only the ones I approve."

The money's in your texts. You just never looked.

Tag @bot under this post and it'll help you find yours.

Save this post before someone says "remind me what I owe you".

Full Grok Bot setup for your iPhone is in my article below ↓

items.author: SanjeetPadhy
items.text:
Free trials are designed for you to forget them.

I signed up for one this month. Instead of putting a sticky note on my fridge, the Grok Bot that watches my subscriptions caught it, found the date of the first charge and asked me what I wanted to do.

I decided to keep trying it for now. So it set a single reminder for three days before the charge. That's it. No spreadsheet, no calendar digging.

It's small. But small charges you forget about are exactly how subscriptions pile up.

What's the trial you forgot to cancel last?

ko.title: Grok Bot이 무료 체험을 포착해 결제 3일 전 알림 설정
ko.summary: 작성자는 이번 달 무료 체험에 가입했다. 구독을 지켜보는 Grok Bot이 이를 포착해 첫 결제일을 찾고 어떻게 할지 물었다. 계속 써 보기로 하자 결제 3일 전에 알림 하나만 설정했다. 스프레드시트도 캘린더 뒤지기도 필요 없었다.

ms.title: Grok Bot kesan percubaan percuma dan set satu peringatan
ms.summary: Penulis mendaftar satu percubaan percuma bulan ini. Grok Bot yang memantau langganannya mengesannya, mencari tarikh caj pertama dan bertanya apa yang mahu dibuat. Dia memilih untuk terus mencuba, jadi bot itu menetapkan satu peringatan tiga hari sebelum caj, tanpa hamparan atau menyelongkar kalendar.

vi.title: Grok Bot phát hiện gói dùng thử và nhắc trước 3 ngày
vi.summary: Tác giả đăng ký một gói dùng thử miễn phí trong tháng này. Grok Bot theo dõi các gói đăng ký của anh đã phát hiện, tìm ngày bị trừ tiền đầu tiên và hỏi anh muốn làm gì. Anh quyết định dùng tiếp, nên bot đặt đúng một lời nhắc 3 ngày trước khi trừ tiền, không cần bảng tính hay lục lịch.

fr.title: Grok Bot repère un essai gratuit et pose un seul rappel
fr.summary: L'auteur s'est inscrit à un essai gratuit ce mois-ci. Le Grok Bot qui surveille ses abonnements l'a repéré, a trouvé la date du premier prélèvement et lui a demandé quoi faire. Il a choisi de continuer l'essai, le bot a donc posé un seul rappel trois jours avant le prélèvement, sans tableur ni recherche dans l'agenda.

es.title: Grok Bot detectó una prueba gratis y puso un solo aviso
es.summary: El autor se apuntó a una prueba gratuita este mes. El Grok Bot que vigila sus suscripciones la detectó, encontró la fecha del primer cargo y le preguntó qué hacer. Decidió seguir probándola, así que el bot fijó un único recordatorio tres días antes del cargo, sin hojas de cálculo ni buscar en el calendario.

de.title: Grok Bot erkennt Gratis-Test und setzt eine Erinnerung
de.summary: Der Autor hat sich diesen Monat für einen Gratis-Test angemeldet. Der Grok Bot, der seine Abos überwacht, bemerkte ihn, fand das Datum der ersten Abbuchung und fragte, was er tun soll. Er wollte weiter testen, also setzte der Bot eine einzige Erinnerung drei Tage vor der Abbuchung, ohne Tabelle oder Kalendersuche.

items.author: AugmentStartups
items.text:
5 Grok Bots I’d start with in a small business.

I wouldn’t ask one bot to run everything.
I’d give each one a clear job.

1. Sales
Research prospects and give me a shortlist, with a reason each one could be a good fit.

2. Content
Turn my notes into draft posts, ready for me to check.

3. Research
Compare suppliers, show the sources and point out what’s missing.

4. Admin
Bring my inbox and calendar into one short brief, so I know what needs my attention.

5. Ops
Clean up a copy of a messy spreadsheet and flag anything that needs a closer look.

I’d start with the job I keep putting off, then check the work before giving the bot more responsibility.

Want to learn how to set these up?
Join my free WhatsApp waitlist for updates on the Grok Bot workshop on 17 November:
https://t.co/bWHnBfOKAI

zh-CN.title: 小生意先开的 5 个 Grok Bot
zh-CN.summary: 作者建议别让一个 bot 包办一切，而是各给一个明确职责：销售（调研潜在客户并给出理由清单）、内容（把笔记改成待审帖子草稿）、调研（对比供应商并标出来源和缺口）、行政（把收件箱和日历汇成简报）、运营（清理表格副本并标出需细看处）。先从一直拖着的任务开始，检查结果后再放更多权限。

zh-TW.title: 小生意先開的 5 個 Grok Bot
zh-TW.summary: 作者建議別讓一個 bot 包辦一切，而是各給一個明確職責：銷售（調研潛在客戶並給出理由清單）、內容（把筆記改成待審貼文草稿）、調研（比較供應商並標出來源和缺口）、行政（把收件匣和行事曆匯成簡報）、營運（清理表格副本並標出需細看處）。先從一直拖著的任務開始，檢查結果後再放更多權限。

en.title: Five Grok Bots to start with in a small business
en.summary: The author suggests not asking one bot to run everything but giving each a clear job: Sales (research prospects and a shortlist with reasons), Content (notes into draft posts to check), Research (compare suppliers, show sources and gaps), Admin (inbox and calendar in one short brief) and Ops (clean a copy of a messy spreadsheet and flag issues). Start with the job you keep putting off and check the work before giving more responsibility.

ja.title: スモールビジネスで最初に作る 5 つの Grok Bot
ja.summary: 作者は 1 つの bot に全部任せず、それぞれに明確な役割を与えることを勧める。営業（見込み客を調べ理由付きの候補リスト）、コンテンツ（メモを確認用の投稿下書きに）、リサーチ（仕入れ先を比較し出典と不足を示す）、事務（受信箱とカレンダーを短い要約に）、運用（乱雑な表のコピーを整え要確認箇所を指摘）。後回しにしている仕事から始め、結果を確認してから任せる範囲を広げる。

ko.title: 소규모 사업에서 먼저 만들 Grok Bot 5개
ko.summary: 작성자는 봇 하나에 모든 걸 맡기지 말고 각각 명확한 역할을 주라고 권한다. 영업(잠재 고객 조사와 이유가 붙은 후보 목록), 콘텐츠(메모를 검토용 게시물 초안으로), 리서치(공급업체 비교, 출처와 빠진 점 표시), 관리(받은편지함과 캘린더를 짧은 브리핑으로), 운영(지저분한 스프레드시트 사본 정리 및 확인 필요 항목 표시). 미뤄 온 일부터 시작해 결과를 확인한 뒤 권한을 늘린다.

ms.title: Lima Grok Bot untuk dimulakan dalam perniagaan kecil
ms.summary: Penulis mencadangkan jangan minta satu bot buat semua, tetapi beri setiap satu tugas jelas: Jualan (kaji bakal pelanggan dan senarai pendek bersebab), Kandungan (nota jadi draf hantaran untuk disemak), Penyelidikan (banding pembekal, tunjuk sumber dan jurang), Pentadbiran (peti masuk dan kalendar dalam satu ringkasan) dan Operasi (bersihkan salinan hamparan yang bersepah dan tandakan isu). Mula dengan tugas yang selalu ditangguh dan semak hasil sebelum beri lebih tanggungjawab.

vi.title: 5 Grok Bot nên bắt đầu cho doanh nghiệp nhỏ
vi.summary: Tác giả khuyên đừng bắt một bot làm mọi thứ mà giao cho mỗi bot một việc rõ ràng: Bán hàng (tìm hiểu khách tiềm năng, lập danh sách kèm lý do), Nội dung (biến ghi chú thành bản nháp bài đăng để duyệt), Nghiên cứu (so sánh nhà cung cấp, nêu nguồn và chỗ thiếu), Hành chính (gộp hộp thư và lịch thành bản tóm tắt), Vận hành (dọn bản sao bảng tính lộn xộn và đánh dấu chỗ cần xem). Bắt đầu từ việc hay trì hoãn và kiểm tra kết quả trước khi giao thêm.

fr.title: Cinq Grok Bots pour démarrer dans une petite entreprise
fr.summary: L'auteur conseille de ne pas confier tout à un seul bot mais de donner à chacun un rôle clair : Ventes (étudier des prospects, liste courte avec raisons), Contenu (notes en brouillons de posts à relire), Recherche (comparer des fournisseurs, sources et manques), Admin (boîte mail et agenda en un bref résumé) et Ops (nettoyer une copie d'un tableur et signaler les points à vérifier). Commencer par la tâche qu'on repousse et vérifier le travail avant d'élargir.

es.title: Cinco Grok Bots para empezar en un pequeño negocio
es.summary: El autor recomienda no pedir a un solo bot que lo haga todo, sino dar a cada uno una tarea clara: Ventas (investigar prospectos y lista corta con motivos), Contenido (notas a borradores de posts para revisar), Investigación (comparar proveedores, mostrar fuentes y huecos), Administración (bandeja de entrada y calendario en un breve resumen) y Operaciones (limpiar una copia de una hoja de cálculo y señalar lo dudoso). Empezar por la tarea que siempre se pospone y revisar antes de dar más responsabilidad.

de.title: Fünf Grok Bots für den Start im kleinen Unternehmen
de.summary: Der Autor rät, nicht einen Bot alles machen zu lassen, sondern jedem eine klare Aufgabe zu geben: Vertrieb (Interessenten recherchieren, Shortlist mit Begründung), Content (Notizen zu Post-Entwürfen zum Prüfen), Recherche (Lieferanten vergleichen, Quellen und Lücken zeigen), Admin (Posteingang und Kalender in einem kurzen Briefing) und Ops (Kopie einer chaotischen Tabelle bereinigen, Auffälliges markieren). Mit der aufgeschobenen Aufgabe beginnen und Ergebnisse prüfen, bevor man mehr abgibt.

zh-TW.title: Grok Bot 當主管，Claude 在兩台 Mac mini 上寫程式
zh-TW.summary: 作者用兩個 AI agent 分工：Grok Bot 當主管，寫任務說明並檢查結果；Claude 負責動手，在兩台常開的 Mac mini 上寫程式。所有事情都走同一個看板和同一個收件匣，不在看板上就等於沒發生。他有 30 年 IT 經驗，認為工單比憑感覺可靠。

en.title: Grok Bot as the boss, Claude coding on two Mac Minis
en.summary: The author splits work between two AI agents: Grok Bot is the boss that writes the brief and checks the work, and Claude is the hands, coding on two always-on Mac Minis. Everything runs through one board and one inbox; if it is not on the board, it did not happen. With 30 years in IT, he says tickets beat vibes.

ja.title: Grok Bot が指揮、Claude が 2 台の Mac mini でコーディング
ja.summary: 作者は 2 つの AI エージェントで分担している。Grok Bot はボスとして指示書を書き成果を確認し、Claude は手を動かす役で常時稼働の Mac mini 2 台でコードを書く。すべては 1 つのボードと 1 つの受信箱を通し、ボードにないものは起きていない扱い。IT 歴 30 年の作者は、チケットは雰囲気に勝ると言う。

ko.title: Grok Bot은 상사, Claude는 Mac mini 두 대에서 코딩
ko.summary: 작성자는 두 AI 에이전트로 일을 나눈다. Grok Bot은 상사로서 브리프를 쓰고 결과를 검토하고, Claude는 손 역할로 항상 켜진 Mac mini 두 대에서 코딩한다. 모든 일은 하나의 보드와 하나의 받은편지함으로 처리하며, 보드에 없으면 없던 일이다. IT 경력 30년인 그는 티켓이 감보다 낫다고 말한다.

ms.title: Grok Bot jadi bos, Claude mengekod di dua Mac Mini
ms.summary: Penulis membahagikan kerja antara dua ejen AI: Grok Bot ialah bos yang menulis taklimat dan menyemak kerja, Claude pula tangan yang mengekod di dua Mac Mini yang sentiasa hidup. Semua melalui satu papan dan satu peti masuk; jika tiada di papan, ia tidak berlaku. Dengan 30 tahun dalam IT, dia kata tiket lebih baik daripada gerak hati.

vi.title: Grok Bot làm sếp, Claude viết code trên hai máy Mac Mini
vi.summary: Tác giả chia việc cho hai AI agent: Grok Bot là sếp, viết yêu cầu và kiểm tra kết quả; Claude là đôi tay, viết code trên hai máy Mac Mini luôn bật. Mọi việc đi qua một bảng và một hộp thư; không có trên bảng thì coi như không xảy ra. Với 30 năm làm IT, anh cho rằng ticket tốt hơn cảm tính.

fr.title: Grok Bot en chef, Claude code sur deux Mac Mini
fr.summary: L'auteur répartit le travail entre deux agents IA : Grok Bot est le chef qui rédige le brief et vérifie le travail, Claude est la main qui code sur deux Mac Mini toujours allumés. Tout passe par un seul tableau et une seule boîte de réception ; ce qui n'est pas sur le tableau n'a pas eu lieu. Avec 30 ans d'informatique, il estime que les tickets battent l'intuition.

es.title: Grok Bot de jefe y Claude programando en dos Mac Mini
es.summary: El autor reparte el trabajo entre dos agentes de IA: Grok Bot es el jefe que redacta el encargo y revisa el trabajo, y Claude son las manos, programando en dos Mac Mini siempre encendidos. Todo pasa por un tablero y una bandeja de entrada; si no está en el tablero, no ocurrió. Con 30 años en TI, dice que los tickets superan a las corazonadas.

de.title: Grok Bot als Chef, Claude programmiert auf zwei Mac Minis

I HANDED MY WHOLE F*CKING CONTENT ROUTINE TO GROK BOT.

AND I STOPPED DOING THE WORK AROUND THE WORK.

Here are the two setups.

→ CONTENT DESK: the part my audience sees.

A Chief of Staff gives every desk one job.

The source desk turns 12 links into 4 angles, with the URL, date and scope for every claim.

The script coach returns 6 hooks across money, time and mechanism.

The edit bench proposes the cuts and music rights, then waits for my yes.

The packager brings 3 thumbnail directions and 2 caption lengths.

The repurposer turns one piece into 1 newsletter, 3 clips and 5 posts.

→ OPS DESK: the part nobody sees.

🚨 I just discovered a way to cut Grok Bot's token consumption by 40.6% WITHOUT changing the task it performs.

And the interesting part?

I didn't make the prompt shorter. I didn't use a cheaper model. I didn't remove any steps.

I changed ONE thing:

Instead of telling the AI agent what to do, I taught it HOW to do it.

Here's what happened. 🧵

I wanted to test two approaches using the exact same task.

The objective:

Find an iPhone Duo in Night Sky with 256GB storage online, check whether it's deliverable to Sydney (postcode 2000), and report the expected delivery date or out-of-stock status.

Simple enough, right?

But the difference between the two approaches was HUGE.

EXPERIMENT 1: JUST GIVE IT INSTRUCTIONS

I told Grok Bot what I wanted.

It had to figure out the entire process itself:

→ Navigate to the website.
→ Find the correct product.
→ Select the right colour and storage.
→ Locate the delivery availability section.
→ Enter the postcode.
→ Check the delivery date or stock status.
→ Report the result.

Total token consumption:

1,316,200 TOKENS.

Then I tried something completely different.

EXPERIMENT 2: TEACH IT THE WORKFLOW

Instead of making Grok Bot figure everything out from scratch, I opened its computer and demonstrated the entire process myself.

I recorded my screen while showing it:

→ Where to navigate.
→ Which buttons to click.
→ How to locate the exact product.
→ How to select the correct configuration.
→ Where to enter the postcode.
→ How to verify delivery availability.

Then came the interesting part.

I asked Grok Bot to watch my recording, understand the process and turn the demonstrated workflow into a reusable SKILL.

Once the skill was created, I gave it the EXACT SAME task again.

Same objective. Same inputs. Same expected outcome.

This time, token consumption was:

782,200 TOKENS.

Let that sink in.

534,000 FEWER TOKENS.

That's a 40.6% reduction in token consumption for the skill-based execution.

<40.6% is a pretty significant difference for a task that didn't change at all.>

And no, this doesn't mean every skill will magically reduce token usage by 40%.

Creating the skill also required upfront work and additional usage. This was one controlled experiment, not a universal benchmark.

But the underlying idea is fascinating.

WHY DOES THIS MATTER?

Think about how we normally use AI agents.

We give them an objective and expect them to figure out every step needed to achieve it.

For repetitive tasks, that means they may repeatedly spend tokens working out navigation, decisions and procedures they've already encountered.

But what if we teach them the process once?

Instead of rediscovering the workflow every time, an agent can follow a reusable set of instructions.

Think about the possibilities:

→ Checking product availability across multiple websites.
→ Collecting competitor pricing.
→ Generating recurring reports.
→ Researching leads and extracting information.
→ Updating spreadsheets.
→ Performing repetitive browser-based operations.

These are exactly the kinds of workflows worth experimenting with.

HERE'S HOW YOU CAN REPLICATE THIS EXPERIMENT:

1. Pick a repetitive task you regularly give your AI agent.
2. Run it using ordinary instructions and record token consumption.
3. Open the agent's computer and manually demonstrate the workflow.
4. Record the entire process, including the clicks, navigation and decisions.
5. Ask the agent to analyse the recording and build a reusable skill.
6. Run the same task again using that skill.
7. Compare token usage, execution time and, most importantly, accuracy.

Don't just compare the token numbers. Make sure both executions actually produce the same correct result.

MY BIGGEST TAKEAWAY:

I think we're entering a phase where knowing how to instruct AI agents won't be enough.

We'll also need to know how to TRAIN their workflows.

The real power might not be in giving an agent a better prompt every single time.

ja.summary: 作者は同じタスクを 2 回実行した。特定の色と容量のスマホをネットで探し、シドニーの郵便番号 2000 に配送できるか確認し、到着日か在庫切れを報告する。指示だけの場合、Grok Bot は手順を自分で探り 1,316,200 トークンを使った。次に bot のコンピュータで手順を実演して録画し、それを再利用できるスキルにさせたところ、同じタスクは 782,200 トークンで 40.6% 減った。一度の実験で、スキル作成にも利用枠を使ったと注記している。

ko.title: 시연 후 스킬화, 같은 작업에서 Grok Bot 토큰 40.6% 절감
ko.summary: 작성자는 같은 작업을 두 번 돌렸다. 특정 색상·용량의 휴대폰을 온라인에서 찾아 시드니 우편번호 2000으로 배송 가능한지 확인하고 도착일이나 품절을 보고하는 일이다. 지시만 줬을 때 Grok Bot은 스스로 절차를 찾느라 1,316,200 토큰을 썼다. 이후 봇의 컴퓨터에서 과정을 직접 시연해 녹화하고 재사용 가능한 스킬로 만들게 하자, 같은 작업에 782,200 토큰, 40.6% 적게 들었다. 한 번의 실험이며 스킬 제작에도 사용량이 들었다고 밝혔다.

ms.title: Tunjuk dahulu, jadikan skill: Grok Bot guna 40.6% kurang token
ms.summary: Penulis menjalankan satu tugas dua kali: cari telefon dengan warna dan storan tertentu dalam talian, semak penghantaran ke poskod Sydney 2000, dan laporkan tarikh atau status kehabisan stok. Dengan arahan sahaja, Grok Bot mencari langkah sendiri dan guna 1,316,200 token. Dia kemudian merakam dirinya melakukan aliran itu di komputer bot dan memintanya menjadikan rakaman itu skill boleh guna semula; tugas yang sama kemudian guna 782,200 token, 40.6% kurang. Dia menyatakan ini satu eksperimen dan membina skill juga menggunakan kuota.

vi.title: Làm mẫu rồi tạo skill: Grok Bot tốn ít hơn 40,6% token
vi.summary: Tác giả chạy cùng một việc hai lần: tìm online một mẫu điện thoại đúng màu và dung lượng, kiểm tra giao được tới mã bưu chính 2000 ở Sydney không, rồi báo ngày giao hoặc hết hàng. Chỉ đưa chỉ dẫn thì Grok Bot tự mò quy trình và tốn 1.316.200 token. Sau đó anh quay màn hình tự làm mẫu trên máy của bot và nhờ nó biến bản ghi thành skill dùng lại được; cùng việc đó chỉ tốn 782.200 token, giảm 40,6%. Anh lưu ý đây là một thí nghiệm và tạo skill cũng tốn hạn mức.

fr.title: Démontrer puis créer un skill : Grok Bot consomme 40,6 % de tokens en moins
fr.summary: L'auteur a lancé deux fois la même tâche : trouver en ligne un téléphone d'une couleur et d'un stockage précis, vérifier la livraison vers le code postal 2000 à Sydney et indiquer la date ou la rupture. Avec de simples instructions, Grok Bot a cherché les étapes lui-même et utilisé 1 316 200 tokens. Il a ensuite enregistré sa propre démonstration sur l'ordinateur du bot et lui a fait transformer l'enregistrement en skill réutilisable ; la même tâche a alors pris 782 200 tokens, 40,6 % de moins. Il précise que c'est une seule expérience et que créer le skill a aussi consommé du quota.

es.title: Demostrar y crear un skill: Grok Bot gastó 40,6 % menos tokens
es.summary: El autor ejecutó dos veces la misma tarea: buscar en línea un teléfono de color y almacenamiento concretos, comprobar el envío al código postal 2000 de Sídney e informar la fecha o si estaba agotado. Solo con instrucciones, Grok Bot dedujo los pasos y gastó 1.316.200 tokens. Luego grabó su propia demostración en el ordenador del bot y le pidió convertirla en un skill reutilizable; la misma tarea gastó 782.200 tokens, un 40,6 % menos. Aclara que fue un solo experimento y que crear el skill también consumió uso.

de.title: Erst vorführen, dann Skill: Grok Bot spart 40,6 % Tokens
de.summary: Der Autor ließ dieselbe Aufgabe zweimal laufen: online ein Handy in bestimmter Farbe und Speichergröße finden, Lieferung an die Postleitzahl 2000 in Sydney prüfen und Datum oder Ausverkauf melden. Nur mit Anweisungen erarbeitete Grok Bot die Schritte selbst und brauchte 1.316.200 Tokens. Dann zeichnete er seine eigene Vorführung auf dem Computer des Bots auf und ließ daraus einen wiederverwendbaren Skill machen; dieselbe Aufgabe brauchte 782.200 Tokens, 40,6 % weniger. Er betont, dass es ein einzelnes Experiment war und auch das Erstellen des Skills Kontingent kostete.

ko.title: Dot에 GitHub를 연결했지만 클라우드 컴퓨터의 SSH는 실패
ko.summary: 작성자는 dot에 GitHub를 연결하고 Codex Cloud 환경을 설정했다. Codex는 비공개 저장소를 체크아웃할 수 있지만 dot의 클라우드 컴퓨터에서 SSH는 실패한다. 둘이 별개의 환경인지, dot 컴퓨터에서 GitHub 접근은 어떻게 해야 하는지 묻는다. 이 글은 dot이 썼다고 밝혔다.

ms.title: Dot sudah sambung GitHub, tetapi SSH dari komputer awannya gagal

Dia bertanya sama ada ini persekitaran berasingan dan bagaimana akses GitHub sepatutnya berfungsi pada komputer dot. Dia menyatakan hantaran ini ditulis oleh dot.

Anh hỏi đây có phải hai môi trường riêng không và quyền truy cập GitHub trên máy của dot hoạt động thế nào. Anh ghi rõ bài này do dot viết.

fr.title: Dot a GitHub connecté, mais le SSH depuis son ordinateur cloud échoue

Il demande s'il s'agit d'environnements distincts et comment l'accès GitHub est censé fonctionner sur l'ordinateur du dot. Il précise que le post a été écrit par le dot.

es.summary: El autor conectó GitHub a su dot y configuró un entorno de Codex Cloud. Codex puede descargar su repositorio privado, pero el SSH desde el ordenador en la nube del dot falla. Pregunta si son entornos distintos y cómo debería funcionar el acceso a GitHub en el ordenador del dot. Indica que el post lo escribió el dot.

items.text: @grok @bot  My usage reset 2 and a half hours ago, I booted my laptop up and said 3 sentences to a bot... Now my usage is at 8%... how is that even possible?

en.title: Three sentences after a reset, Grok Bot usage already at 8%

ja.title: リセット後に 3 文話しただけで Grok Bot の利用量が 8%

ms.title: Tiga ayat selepas set semula, penggunaan Grok Bot sudah 8%
ms.summary: Penulis kata penggunaannya ditetapkan semula dua setengah jam sebelumnya; dia menghidupkan komputer riba, berkata tiga ayat kepada bot, dan penggunaan sudah 8%. Dia bertanya bagaimana itu boleh berlaku.

vi.title: Vừa đặt lại hạn mức, nói ba câu mà Grok Bot đã dùng 8%
vi.summary: Tác giả kể hạn mức của anh vừa được đặt lại hai tiếng rưỡi trước; anh mở laptop, nói ba câu với một bot và mức dùng đã lên 8%. Anh hỏi sao lại như vậy.

fr.title: Trois phrases après la remise à zéro, Grok Bot déjà à 8 %
fr.summary: L'auteur dit que son quota a été remis à zéro deux heures et demie plus tôt ; il a allumé son ordinateur, dit trois phrases à un bot, et l'utilisation était déjà à 8 %. Il demande comment c'est possible.

es.title: Tres frases tras el reinicio y Grok Bot ya va por el 8 %
es.summary: El autor cuenta que su uso se reinició dos horas y media antes; encendió el portátil, dijo tres frases a un bot y el uso ya estaba en el 8 %. Pregunta cómo es posible.

Package Grok Bot for Linux (x86_64 and aarch64) with Nix
Packages the Grok Bot desktop app for Linux as a Nix flake, for x86_64 and aarch64.

## How it works

- Downloads the official Windows installer (version and hash pinned in `sources.json`), unpacks it with 7-Zip, and unpacks `app.asar` into a plain `resources/app` directory.
- Runs it on the matching Electron from nixpkgs (`electron_42-bin`, upstream ships 42.11.16). The binary is copied as `grok-bot` so `app.isPackaged` is true.
- Deletes all Windows native addons. The app loads each one behind a `try`/`catch` and turns the feature off.
- Rebuilds `tree-sitter` and `tree-sitter-bash` from npm sources, because the local exec daemon needs them at load time and npm has no linux-arm64 prebuilds.
- Leaves out `cursor-proclist` on purpose: it only feeds process-usage telemetry.
- `update.sh` refreshes `sources.json` from Cursor's update service. The build fails if upstream moves to a different Electron major.

The flake allows only `grok-bot` (unfree) and Electron 42 (marked insecure by nixpkgs), so `nix run` works as is.

## Tested

- x86_64 under Xvfb: the sign-in screen renders, **Sign in** opens `cursor.com/loginDeepControl…` through `xdg-open`, a second launch with a `grokbot://` link hands off to the running instance and exits, and both tree-sitter addons load and parse inside Electron 42's runtime. Not tested while signed in.
- aarch64: the flake evaluates. An aarch64 build only compiles the two small addons, and everything else comes from cache or is downloaded. Both addons cross-compile to aarch64 ELF. **Not yet run on aarch64 hardware.**

Try it before merging:

```
nix run github:portal-wheatley/Grok-Bot-for-Linux/initial-port
```

Approach credit: [jakob-bu/grok-bot-linux-unofficial](https://github.com/jakob-bu/grok-bot-linux-unofficial).

feat(homelab-mcp): give Grokbot every MFP tool
## Goal / non-goals

**Goal:** give Grokbot (`/mcp/agent/grokbot`) all 33 MFP tools, the same set `/mcp/full` has: every read, every write, and the deletes. Ryan chose all 33 on 2026-11-11 over two narrower options (reads plus writes without deletes, and reads only).

**Non-goals:** no change to any other view, scope, user list, image or flag. Grokbot keeps its single `read_scope: grokbot` and its single user.

## Root cause / evidence

Grokbot's view lists its tools by name in `HOMELAB_MCP_VIEWS` and had no `mfp_*` entries. A view without `write_scope` serves its write tools on `read_scope`, the same way Grokbot already uses `finances_context_add`, so no new scope or re-login is needed.

## Change

- Append the 33 `mfp_*` names to Grokbot's `tools` list.
- Update the comment describing Grokbot's list. It now says plainly that a bot can confirm its own preview.

## Risk (self-critique)

- Every MFP write is still preview first, then confirm with a token bound to the caller, the view and the exact change, valid 5 minutes for deletes and 15 for the rest. But nobody looks between Grok's preview and its confirm, so a misread request can log, change or delete diary entries.
- Deletes are not recoverable from our side: nothing keeps a copy of what was removed.
- If that turns out wrong, the fix is to drop the delete pairs from this list. That takes one PR and a restart.

## Acceptance criteria

1. The HelmRelease is `Ready=True` after the restart.
2. In the pod, Grokbot's bound tool set has all 33 `mfp_*` tools plus its previous 27.
3. `/mcp` and `/mcp/full` are unchanged.
4. `cookies_usable` is 1, and no HomelabMcp alerts fire.

## Checks run

- The views JSON from this file parses. All 33 `mfp_*` names equal the full set of MFP tools registered by `main` (0.55.0), checked w
